critique.evidence: Document overflow is absent at 1440, 768, and 390 px; measured touch-target violations are zero; the section navigation is keyboard reachable; and reduced-motion testing shows no hero transform or opacity animation. However, WCAG evidence remains materially incomplete at every viewport: 484–553 contrast checks, six serious prohibited-ARIA checks, and two critical duplicate-ID/ARIA checks. Keyboard evidence covers only section navigation, not Atlas tabs, filtering, vector selection, focus visibility, or operation within the horizontally clipped data region. Skip-link dimensions are measured, but activation and focus transfer are not proven.
critique.fix: Resolve and rerun all incomplete axe checks: give ARIA references unique IDs, remove prohibited ARIA attributes, and verify every flagged foreground/background pair meets WCAG contrast. Add end-to-end keyboard tests for tabs, the stage selector, vector cards, detail updates, focus order, and visible focus; verify the skip link transfers focus correctly. Demonstrate keyboard access and discoverability for horizontally overflowed Atlas content at tablet/mobile widths, then retest touch targets and reduced motion.
